individual_embeddings.description: A cartoon chicken stands on a wooden deck in a backyard, facing a large, outstretched chicken wing. A tricycle rests nearby on grass, with a swing set and wooden fence in the background. The scene is bathed in warm, golden-hour light, suggesting late afternoon. The setting is residential, with houses visible beyond the fence. No readable text is present.

A wooden deck foreground features a teal pet bowl with a bone symbol. Behind, a grassy backyard contains a tricycle and a blue swing set. A wooden fence encloses the yard, with houses and trees visible beyond. Warm, golden-hour lighting bathes the scene, suggesting late afternoon. No people or animals are present.
